title: KohakuRAG: A simple RAG framework with hierarchical document indexing
authors: Shih-Ying Yeh; Yueh-Feng Ku; Ko-Wei Huang; Buu-Khang Tu
why_relevant: Proposes a hierarchical RAG framework with ensemble voting and abstention filtering for a benchmark challenge. Touches abstention but is primarily a system paper, not robustness-focused.
why_not_or_caveat: Does not study noise, distraction, conflict, attacks, calibration, or OOD in any substantive way beyond abstention voting on a single challenge.
